capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Lexus USA lists two packs, 76.96 and 95.82 kWh; TFLcar/InsideEVs: Premium 77 kWh, Premium Touring 96 kWh; gross vs usable not stated.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: battery preconditioning standard; Lexus release: "Optimizes battery temperature before charging in cold conditions", 5G-dependent, subscription. The Lexus TZ page names battery preconditioning but not its trigger; assumed as on the Lexus ES (touchscreen or automatic with a charger as destination), not confirmed.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Auto-Data.net: battery voltage 385 V for the TZ 450e 95.82 kWh. Toyota press release: 312 cells in this pack vs 104 in the 76.96 kWh pack (400 V class, src-insideevs-bz-charging-limit-2026).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: platform sibling with the same pack. Lexus says the TZ 95.82 kWh pack is the Toyota Highlander EV 95.8 kWh pack (Toyota Liberty NC assembly); GreenCars reports LG Energy Solution pouch cells with nickel-manganese-cobalt-aluminum cathode (NMCA, recorded as nmc). Toyota states "lithium-ion" only (src-r2-lexus-tz-global-pr).

ac_max_kw.notes: TFLcar: "All versions of the TZ come with an 11-kW onboard AC charger" (19 kW optional).

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs: 150 kW peak for the large battery.

published_10_80_min.notes: About 35 minutes 10-80% for the large battery, "per the automaker".
